integrity.euler_basis: Toric orbit additivity reduces Euler characteristic to the number of polytope vertices, which are fence ideals.

scientific_limitations: Only torus fixed-point smoothness is classified; the full singular locus is not decomposed.
The family is the alternating fence poset, not arbitrary fence compositions or tree posets.
The global degree and Euler formulas are classical consequences of order-polytope theory; the assessed new content is the uniform local smoothness classification and exact crossover.
title: Fixed-point singularity saturation in fence Hibi toric varieties
